concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-reports-and-fees-fee-report]] — 2026-09-15 monthly Balance Platform Fee Report for user/liable incurred-fee categories, optional account columns and invoice reconciliation; row location does not identify billing debit or transaction-level booking.
warnings: The documented sample/standard schema has no transaction ID and differs on Currency versus Currency Code; generated columns may vary. The report states where fees were incurred, not where billed, and does not prove a balance debit, invoice payment or bank receipt.
